title: Replace the fixture but retain a shared calibration chain
description: A fictional laboratory proposes a replacement fixture. Its two analysis computers agree, but both use one generated geometry file. An auxiliary measurement disagrees and has been labeled unreliable without a documented cause.
decision_requested: Decide whether to close acceptance of the replacement fixture and select the next discriminating check.
constraints: No numerical uncertainty budget is supplied.
No result may be discarded solely because it disagrees with the preferred instrument.
This is a metrology review exercise, not an optical redesign.
